title: Argumentación, postura y cautela
objective: Sostener una opinión matizada y calibrar el grado de certeza.

sections.title: Vocabulario
sections.explanation: Aprende las palabras y expresiones necesarias para argumentación, postura y cautela. Escucha, repite y úsalas en frases propias.

sections.title: Gramática
sections.explanation: El hedging reduce afirmaciones demasiado absolutas: may, might, appear to, tend to, arguably. La elección depende de cuánto respalda la evidencia.
sections.form: may/might + verb; appear to + verb; tend to + verb; arguably + clause
examples: The policy may have helped some residents.
The results appear to be consistent.

additional_topics.title: Inversión en condicionales formales
additional_topics.explanation: En registros formales puede omitirse if e invertir had, were o should. El significado condicional se mantiene, pero la forma resulta más concisa y marcada.
additional_topics.form: Had + subject + participle; Were + subject + to; Should + subject + verb
examples: Had I known, I would have helped.
Should you need assistance, call us.

sections.title: Phrasal verbs y verbos con partícula
sections.explanation: Aprende el significado completo de cada expresión: la partícula puede cambiar el sentido del verbo. Practica la expresión dentro de una frase.

items.example: The committee put forward an alternative.
The figures bear out the claim.
We must weigh up the evidence.
The new data call the claim into question.
The report homes in on the weakest evidence.

sections.title: Listening
sections.explanation: Escucha el audio dos veces. Primero identifica la idea principal; después busca los datos concretos.
sections.script: The commentator argues that the pilot scheme shows promise, although the evidence is less decisive than the headline suggests. Participation increased in two districts but remained stable elsewhere. She cautions against declaring the policy a success before longer-term data are available, while accepting that the early results justify further trials.

sections.title: Speaking
sections.explanation: Responde en voz alta. Da información pertinente y añade un detalle o razón cuando puedas.
prompts: C1 Advanced, exposición individual: Compare two situations in which people must make decisions with incomplete evidence.
C1 Advanced, discusión colaborativa: Evaluate several ways a public body could explain uncertainty to citizens and agree on the best approach.

Costs were estimated carefully, whereas predicted changes in behaviour relied on a small survey. The author did not reject the reform; instead, she called for a staged trial with clear measures of success.

All I asked for was a clear answer.

title: Ciencia, incertidumbre y causalidad

sections.title: Gramática
sections.explanation: Las cleft sentences destacan información específica: It is/was X that... o What... is/was X. Úsalas para centrar la atención en el factor relevante.
sections.form: It is/was + focus + that/who...; What + clause + is/was + focus
examples: It was the sample size that limited the study.

title: Colocaciones, modismos y registro
objective: Elegir expresiones naturales sin perder precisión ni adecuación.

sections.title: Vocabulario
sections.explanation: Aprende las palabras y expresiones necesarias para colocaciones, modismos y registro. Escucha, repite y úsalas en frases propias.

sections.title: Gramática
sections.explanation: Las colocaciones son combinaciones habituales: draw a conclusion, raise awareness, meet a deadline. El registro determina si una expresión coloquial o idiomática resulta apropiada.
sections.form: verb + noun collocation; register appropriate to reader
examples: The report raises awareness of the issue.
The team met the deadline.

sections.title: Phrasal verbs y verbos con partícula
sections.explanation: Aprende el significado completo de cada expresión: la partícula puede cambiar el sentido del verbo. Practica la expresión dentro de una frase.

items.example: I brushed up on my French.
He came across as confident.

The examiner zeroed in on the main weakness.

sections.title: Listening
sections.explanation: Escucha el audio dos veces. Primero identifica la idea principal; después busca los datos concretos.
sections.script: A writing tutor noted that advanced learners often know many impressive words but choose them in unnatural combinations. She advised students to keep a record of phrases encountered in reliable texts and to check whether a phrase suits a formal report or an informal conversation. Accuracy, she argued, matters more than sounding elaborate.

The reviewer suggested replacing such wording with direct verbs, while keeping technical terms where they carried a precise meaning.

title: Síntesis C1 y preparación integral
objective: Integrar lectura crítica, escucha, interacción y escritura avanzada.

sections.title: Vocabulario
sections.explanation: Aprende las palabras y expresiones necesarias para síntesis c1 y preparación integral. Escucha, repite y úsalas en frases propias.

sections.title: Gramática
sections.explanation: En una transformación de C1, conserva exactamente el significado y usa la palabra clave sin modificar. Revisa matices de tiempo, modalidad, negación y énfasis.
sections.form: source sentence + key word → equivalent sentence (3–6 words en el formato de examen)
examples: I regret not applying. → WISH → I wish I had applied.
We seldom see this. → RARELY → Rarely do we see this.

sections.title: Phrasal verbs y verbos con partícula
